title: Scheduled recheck, 3 Oct 2026 (17 queued items)
scope: Scheduled recheck of the 17 queued items (13 withheld Gold+ grades, 1 plan, 3 official mechanics notices) against the live Gold+ and Bronze+ bundles published 2026-10-03T03:32:16Z (Pred.gg 1.17 + Hotfix 1.17.1, collected 2 Oct). Not a weekly or full review.
standard: docs/RECHECK-RUNNER.md with the 2.34 / 27 Sep grade standard (docs/STRATEGY-REVIEW-2.34.md, docs/GRADE-RECHECK-2026-09-27.md): one step at most; a move needs a kit or patch reason with evidence pointing the same way; a grade may drop one step without a kit reason when the whole-line 95% interval excludes the previous review rate with at least 500 games and the games since review agree; a high rate alone never raises a grade. Mechanics notices resolve only with official text.

entries.reason: No 1.17 Adele change. The whole-line rate rose from her 1.16.4 review rate (44.3%), but the 95% interval still includes it and a higher rate alone never raises a grade. C retained; the watch no longer says the 1.17 sample is under 100 games. Gold+ whole 1.17 line 47.8% over 735 [44.2, 51.4]; Bronze+ 47.0% over 1898 (nested). Since the 2.34 review: 47.0% over 636.
entries.limitation: The rise has no kit or patch reason; the interval includes the old rate by 0.1 points.

entries.reason: Kit reason: 1.17 cut magical-power scaling on Hellfire, Web Lash, Crushing Maw and Consume (the Crushing Maw bonus-health gain is small). The evidence now points the same way: the whole-line 95% interval excludes his 1.16.4 review rate (52.9%) with over 500 games, and the games since the 2.34 review ran lower still. A drops one step to B. He is the lowest A jungle by more than two points, below several B junglers. Gold+ whole 1.17 line 46.0% over 511 [41.7, 50.3]; Bronze+ 43.1% over 882 (nested). Since the 2.34 review: 45.6% over 454.
entries.limitation: 511 games is just over the 500-game line; Bronze+ (nested) is lower still. "Since review" is the whole line minus the 2.34 early sample, assuming that sample is contained in it.

entries.reason: Kit reason: 1.17 cut magical scaling on Hellfire, Web Lash and Consume and on Crushing Maw (40% to 35%) while raising its bonus-health scaling (4% to 4.5%). The 2.34 review judged the swap neutral for a health build; the results now say it is a net loss: the whole-line 95% interval excludes his 1.16.4 review rate (52.3%), and the games since the 2.34 review ran lower. A drops one step to B. He is the lowest A offlaner, level with B Crunch. Offlane pool: Akeron moves to last, behind Shinbi (the pool order follows a moved grade); the offlane note says so. Gold+ whole 1.17 line 48.4% over 1427 [45.8, 51.0]; Bronze+ 48.6% over 2459 (nested). Since the 2.34 review: 47.8% over 1256.
entries.limitation: The magic-scaling cut and the health-scaling gain are not separately measured; the result is a net judgment. Bronze+ (nested) agrees.

entries.reason: The flagged change is wording only. Pred.gg (version 168) now writes Rallying Roar's official 1.17 cooldown as "(20s CD)." instead of omitting it, so the plan's precondition, which states the same 20-second cooldown in the supplement's words, no longer matched letter for letter. The mechanic is unchanged from the 2.32 review (+10 Ultimate Haste; casting the ultimate grants +25% movement speed to allies within 1500 units for 4s; 20s cooldown), so the plan's reasoning holds and no part changes. The supplement now accepts the source's wording (see the corrections entries), so the precondition matches again. The caution's claim that the source tooltip omits the cooldown is out of date and is rewritten.
entries.limitation: The loadout comparison behind Scorched Earth is still the 1.16 Statz comparison from the 2.32 review; this recheck did not re-run it.
mechanics_checked: Rallying Roar description (Pred.gg 168 against the official 1.17 change)

entries.reason: Official 1.17: "Rallying Roar" now has a 20s cooldown. Pred.gg (version 168, all six ranks) now carries it as "Gain +10 Ultimate Haste. Casting your Ultimate grants you and Allies within 1500 Units +25% Movement Speed for 4s. (20s CD).", which is the rule's "before" text plus the official cooldown. The correction failed only because the source had already been updated in its own words. That wording is added to accepted_before, so the official correction applies over it (the original stays in the receipt) and the reconciliation conflict clears.
entries.limitation: Settled by the official 1.17 notes and the source text alone; no in-game test.

entries.reason: Official 1.17: "Peal" now has a 20s cooldown. Pred.gg (version 168, all six ranks) now carries it as "Gain 15 Ultimate Ability Haste. Upon casting your Ultimate, Basic Attacks and Abilities apply the maximum amount of Rust stacks for 4s. (20s CD).", which is the rule's "before" text plus the official cooldown. The correction failed only because the source had already been updated in its own words. That wording is added to accepted_before, so the official correction applies over it (the original stays in the receipt) and the reconciliation conflict clears.
entries.limitation: Settled by the official 1.17 notes and the source text alone; no in-game test.

entries.reason: Psychosis: the official 1.16.4 change (bonus damage 3.5% (+0.4% per level) to 3% (+0.3% per level)) matches the live Pred.gg (version 168) description exactly, and the correction receipt in all six live bundles reads "source already updated" through its Pred.gg source check. Nothing in the review files needs to change. The warning stays because the publisher adds it at the first correction pass (the Statz field was unavailable) and does not remove it after the Pred.gg check verifies the field; clearing it is a code change, raised for the owner as a DECISION NEEDED issue.
entries.limitation: The notice will keep re-queuing until the code drops a warning whose receipt was later verified.

entries.reason: Frost Snap: The official 1.14 description names immobilized targets. The Statz catalog also names slowed targets. Whether a slow alone qualifies remains unverified; both sources agree on the 10% bonus against immobilized targets. No official notes up to 1.17 and Hotfix 1.17.1 settle this field, so the definition stays partly verified and the field stays explicitly unverified.
entries.limitation: Only official text may resolve it; the community catalogs disagree with the official notes and are not used.

entries.reason: Harmonic Currents: The 1.16 release notes specify 2.5% of missing health and mana; the Statz catalog specifies 2%. The 1.16.4 notes explicitly change timing, but do not resolve the amount. No official notes up to 1.17 and Hotfix 1.17.1 settle this field, so the definition stays partly verified and the field stays explicitly unverified.
entries.limitation: Only official text may resolve it; the community catalogs disagree with the official notes and are not used.

Later published changes update the healing percentages without resolving this duration discrepancy. No official notes up to 1.17 and Hotfix 1.17.1 settle this field, so the definition stays partly verified and the field stays explicitly unverified.
